name: Mahlon
overview: Mahlon is identified in Scripture as one of the two sons of Elimelech and Naomi who moved to Moab (Ruth 1:2). He is notably recognized as the first husband of Ruth, the Moabitess, whose loyalty and faithfulness are highlighted in the narrative. Mahlon’s death, along with his brother Chilion’s, left Naomi bereft of her husband and sons (Ruth 1:5). Later, Boaz redeems Mahlon’s inheritance and marries Ruth to preserve Mahlon’s family line and name, demonstrating God’s providential care in maintaining the legacy of His people (Ruth 4:9-10).
